tagline: 柯达便携相机，1963 年发布
description: 柯达于1963年推出的便携相机。配备43mm f/11。快门速度mechanical leaf, 1/90 sec. and 1/40 sec. with flash popped up。使用126 film cartridge。

specs.快门: mechanical leaf, 1/90 sec. and 1/40 sec. with flash popped up
specs.英文简介: The model 100 was one of Kodak's first Instamatic cameras released in the USA, along with Kodak's introduction of the drop-in 126 film (Kodapak) cartridge.
